card.title: The Detail That Makes It Official
card.instruction: Choose one tiny procedural detail—wording, order, timing, seating, or a mark—and treat it as the only source of legitimacy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your club resignation has the seal upside down. You're still our secretary.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've moved abroad. Rotate the page.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There. Now your resignation is valid.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Good. You can stop sending me the minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll rotate the previous eleven too. We may owe you a year's subscriptions.

mechanism: A treats the seal's orientation as the sole determinant of a resignation and applies its correction retrospectively to dues.
confusable: Unlike adding more procedural hurdles, A allows the same tiny condition to settle the matter even when that favors B.
comparison: The resignation alternative changes validity through rotation and owes money; the marriage alternative changes the celebration's status through a moved dot.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
